name: Google Reader
notes: Google announced sunset on March 13, 2013; permanently shut down July 1, 2013.

name: GeoCities
notes: Acquired by Yahoo in 1999 for $3.57B; shut down on October 26, 2009.

name: Vine
notes: Acquired by Twitter in 2012; Twitter announced shutdown in October 2016.

name: Grooveshark
notes: Ceased operations on April 30, 2015 as part of copyright settlement.

name: Adobe Flash Player
notes: Adobe officially retired and blocked Flash Player on December 31, 2020.

name: StumbleUpon
notes: Shut down by founder Garrett Camp on June 30, 2018; transitioned to Mix.com.

name: Yahoo Answers
notes: Shut down by Yahoo on May 4, 2021.

name: Picnik
notes: Acquired by Google in 2010; retired on April 19, 2012.

name: AltaVista
notes: Acquired by Yahoo via Overture; shut down on July 8, 2013.

name: ICQ
notes: VK officially terminated ICQ services on June 26, 2024.

name: del.icio.us
notes: Acquired by Yahoo in 2005, sold to AVOS in 2011, acquired by Pinboard in 2017 and deactivated.

name: AOL Instant Messenger (AIM)
notes: Oath/Verizon officially terminated AIM on December 15, 2017.

name: Google+
notes: Google shut down the consumer version on April 2, 2019.

name: Microsoft Zune
notes: Hardware discontinued in 2011; music and streaming services retired on November 15, 2015.

name: Pebble
notes: Fitbit acquired Pebble software assets on December 7, 2016; cloud servers shut down June 2018.
